pageTitle: TRAVELS Project 1 – RAV Demand Analysis and User Needs

hero.eyebrow: Tribal & Rural Autonomous Vehicles for Efficiency, Livability and Safety
hero.title: RAV Demand Analysis and User Needs Assessment
hero.lead: What do rural residents, seniors, and people with disabilities need from autonomous vehicles? This task, led by UW-Milwaukee, surveys those needs and forecasts demand for rural AV services.

footer.after: program, funded by the U.S. Department of Transportation Rural Autonomous Vehicle (RAV) Program. Lead institution: University of Wisconsin-Madison.
